apps.subtitle: Battery, charging and thermal instrument
apps.localizedDescription: An iPhone battery and charging monitor built on Apple's private APIs: the charger's real watts, how much of that reaches the cell, where the rest goes as heat, and every temperature sensor in the phone. No network code — nothing it reads leaves your phone.

versions.localizedDescription:
Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing.
https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install

## 新功能

- **主屏幕与锁屏小组件**：显示充电功率和电量。刷新时间由 iOS 决定，通常 15–60 分钟一次，每个小组件都会标明数据的读取时间。
- **充电实时活动**：在锁屏和灵动岛显示充电功率。只在 MiniWatts 运行时更新，App 被挂起后会显示为已暂停。可以在设置里关闭。
- **悬浮读数**：在设置里手动打开的画中画小窗，浮在其他 App 上方，每秒更新一次；开着的时候锁屏也能继续记录充电。会更耗电，用完请关掉。不会播放任何声音。

## 修复

- 部分机型温度读数离谱（比如充电芯片 −9199.4 °C）：物理上不可能的温度现在会被隐藏，不再显示。

## 说明

- 关于页加入了开源说明和 GitHub 地址。
- 这个版本在 iPhone Air 上开发和验证。传感器的名称和换算因机型而异，其他机型可能有读数不准，欢迎带上机型标识反馈。
- 小组件会多占用一个 App ID（免费 Apple ID 每周 10 个）。签名工具如果提示移除扩展，移除后就没有小组件了。

---

## New

- **Home Screen and Lock Screen widget** showing charge power and level. iOS decides when it refreshes — usually every 15 to 60 minutes — and each widget shows when its numbers were taken.
- **Charging Live Activity** on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. It updates only while MiniWatts is running and shows as paused once the app is suspended. Can be turned off in Settings.
- **Floating meter**: a Picture in Picture window you open from Settings. It floats over other apps, updates once a second, and keeps recording the charge with the screen locked. Uses more battery, so close it when you're done. It plays no sound.

## Fixed

- Impossible temperatures on some models (a charge IC at −9199.4 °C) are now hidden instead of shown.

## Notes

- About now says MiniWatts is free and open source, with a link to this repository.
- Built and verified on an iPhone Air. Sensor names and scaling differ between models, so some readings may be wrong on yours — please report them with your model identifier.
- The widget extension takes one more App ID when you sign (a free Apple ID gets ten a week). If your signing tool offers to remove extensions, the widget goes with them.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts/compare/v1.0.1...v1.1.0
